This endpoint allows you to check the status of the most recent configuration process:

Note that you may need to wait several seconds after you start a process before you can check its status.

The different statuses are:

| Status        | Description                       |
| - |  |
| `PENDING`     | The job has not started yet       |
| `CONFIGURING` | The job is running                |
| `DONE`        | The job has finished correctly    |
| `FAILED`      | The job has finished unexpectedly |

This endpoint is typically called during the initial setup phase when administrators need to establish basic system settings such as management console password, hostname, and other foundational configurations. The API operation triggers the configuration workflow that prepares the instance for use, and it returns a response indicating whether the configuration process has successfully started or if any errors occurred during initialization.
